product.olivetti-philos-46.summary: The Philos 46 from the range expansion announced at CeBIT 1994.
product.olivetti-philos-46.history: Olivetti expanded its business notebook range with the Philos 45, 46 and 48 at CeBIT 1994. MCmicrocomputer identifies the 46 among the new models.
product.olivetti-philos-46.architecture: The processor distinguishes this configuration in the CeBIT announcement. MCmicrocomputer identifies it as Intel i486DX2 · 50 MHz.
product.olivetti-philos-46.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-philos-46.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
